 Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) to be re-evaluated in 3-4 weeks 
 by Nicholas Rodriguez | Cavaliers Correspondent | Sat, Oct 24th 2026, 4:07am EDT 
 Nae'Qwan Tomlin was diagnosed with a lower back stress reaction and will be re-evaluated in three to four weeks. ( NBA ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Tomlin missed all three of the Cleveland Cavaliers' preseason games and will miss at least another three weeks. His absence will not impact the Cavaliers' rotation.
